item.title: Knife Terminal 1.3.12
item.description:
• New style: ghostty — click style: in the footer. Ghostty's stock dark and Tomorrow light colors, JetBrains Mono in the terminal, Helvetica Now Text in the chrome when installed (system font otherwise). From Eddie Cohen's PR #1.
  • Shells identify as Knife (TERM_PROGRAM=KnifeTerminal) instead of inheriting the launcher's terminal (Ghostty etc.).
  • Faster folder lookups for each tab (proc_pidinfo instead of lsof).
